query: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(:Spec {specNumber:'38.213'}), (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT agr.resolutionId,coalesce(agr.contentWithEquations,agr.content) AS content,m.meetingNumber,m.meetingNumberInt ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,agr.resolutionId ASC,m.meetingNumber ASC,content ASC LIMIT 10
